wall: network clocks relative, never sum worker durations as latency; union lower=max duration; upper uses enclosing wrapper span and each worker duration minus last trace to bound its unknown start offset; first two worker intervals overlap
CPU: process CPU counters: common RTC intersection gives lower bound, union envelope gives upper (may include CAL on early finisher); no exclusive per-thread CPU attribution claimed
readiness: published READY contains map/guard/measurements. Parent50ms poll gives caller-detected readiness; poll timestamp sampled before path check may precede publication by a few ms. Analysis and command exit separate.
memory: sampled aggregate process-tree RSS50ms, not OS pressure or continuous high-water
phase: all normal required spectra, output and endpoints included; capture/response timings excluded from3REF repetitions; no overhead subtraction
